mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'

No current decision on the wire serialisation format is recorded for this project. The earlier serialisation-format decisions were withdrawn, and no replacement has been recorded, so no format is specified here.

cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no current wire serialisation decision is recorded, so it names no format.

The recorded decisions first standardised on msgpack and then switched to CBOR. A later recorded decision (observation 13) withdrew that whole series of technology decisions, including the serialisation one. It said effort would shift to build verification, and no replacement was recorded. The file doesn't mention msgpack or CBOR, since you asked me not to describe retired alternatives.

`docs/doc.md` only covers Gin's optional MsgPack rendering feature. It doesn't record a project decision, so I didn't use it.
